title: Hot Lips Page and unremembered players
summary: Lips Page is another unmentioned player, and Dickenson compares forgotten musicians to a worn-out discarded toy.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: I thought one guy who always was underrated was Lips Page.

There's another one no one ever says anything about. There are so many guys, guys that people don't say anything about. You know what I mean? They're Alas (?) and they're gone and forgotten. It's like a toy that you throwed away; it got worn out. They don't even remember that toy no more.

Well, it could be that the way that people look at the past and what is called Jazz history, which really hasn't been fully explored, and that's one of the reasons why we are here together, among other things...
But some people's role has maybe been over-emphasized, and they're sort of overshadowed on the others...
